study type: Retrospective case series and literature review
cohort: Fourteen patients with pathologically confirmed intraplacental choriocarcinoma (IC) treated in Peking Union Medical College Hospital between January 2002 and July 2022, alongside 89 cases reviewed from literature.
finding: Intraplacental choriocarcinoma (IC) is sensitive to chemotherapy, showing good long-term remission and a low recurrence rate, with patients capable of achieving good pregnancy results after treatment.
